_DESIGN_RULE: A FLAT list of exactly 6 needs, paired 1:1 with the 6 products. v2's 3x3 categories existed to power a two-tier category-then-specific reveal; that reveal is gone (Trust thresholds now reveal a need outright), so categories would be pure decoration and were deleted. The count of 6 is load-bearing on the blind-pitch gamble: 2 needs out of 6 is a 33% blind hit, and each miss narrows it (2/5, 2/4, 2/3). Change 6 and you change the whole risk curve.
